notes.title: November 28 patch notes
notes.content:
Optimized the performance of glowing objects in the game, and now glowing objects are closer to reality.
Added an eye glow effect to zombies, making it easier to target zombies in the dark

notes.title: November 20th Patch Notes
notes.content: Fix display bugs (including zombies, firearms, and dropped objects invisible bugs)

notes.title: Update Notes for October 30
notes.content:
1. Added several localized languages ​​(including Japanese, Korean, and Chinese);
2. Adjusted the probability of zombie item drops. Now the probability of zombie item drops will be adjusted according to the number of zombies on the field. In simple terms, the more zombies there are, the higher the probability of zombie item drops.

notes.title: Update instructions for October 28th
notes.content:
change:
1. Modify hud
2. Fixed the issue where zombies do not refresh after replaying the game after death.
